local.headline: Commission to vote on data center rules; Millington launches $2 ride service
body: The Shelby County Commission is set to vote on a framework for land-use rules covering data centers, according to the Daily Memphian. The Daily Memphian also reported that MLGW's CEO discussed proposed rate increases.

FOX13 Memphis reported that an on-demand ride service costing $2 a trip starts in Millington on Monday. Action News 5 said the week will start cooler and brisk, with rain possible around Wednesday's Thanksgiving travel.

sources.title: Commission preview of data center land-use rules
MLGW leader discusses proposed rate increases
Millington on-demand ride service launches Monday
Forecast for a cooler week with Wednesday rain

state.headline: Blackburn team forms DCS advisory group; state returns record unclaimed property
body: The transition team for incoming Gov. Blackburn has formed a four-person advisory group, led by former Department of Children's Services leader Jim Henry, to review the department, according to the Tennessee Lookout. The Chattanooga Times Free Press reported that the state returned $111.5 million in unclaimed property to 169,303 owners, a record.
WSMV reported that death row attorneys are asking for a wider review of Tennessee's execution procedures after two executions this year that they describe as "botched".

sources.title: Blackburn names advisory group to review DCS
State returns record amount of unclaimed property
Attorneys seek wider review of execution procedures

federal.headline: Democrat projected to win North Carolina House race; Delta delays hit holiday travel
body: CBS News and ABC News reported that Democrat Chuck Hubbard is projected to defeat Republican Rep. Virginia Foxx in North Carolina's 5th District. ABC News said the projection followed a recount.

PBS NewsHour, CBS News and ABC News reported that a technical problem at Delta Air Lines caused delays on Sunday, mostly at its Atlanta hub, as Americans began Thanksgiving travel. PBS NewsHour said the FAA issued a ground stop.

sources.title: Projection of Hubbard win over Foxx
Hubbard projected to win after recount
Delta automation problem delays holiday travelers
Delta delays tied to a baggage system issue

international.headline: UN climate talks end without a deal; Ukraine and Libya attacks draw UN attention
body: PBS NewsHour and UN News reported that the COP31 climate talks ended without an agreement. Delegates told PBS NewsHour the draft lacked wording on fossil fuels, and UN Secretary-General Guterres said the science is clear.

The UN Security Council met on attacks on Ukraine's power grid and Black Sea shipping, UN News reported. The Associated Press, via the Chattanooga Times Free Press, said a Russian strike near Kyiv hit an apartment building and killed at least three people. CBS News reported suspected Ukrainian drones struck a Russian warship at a naval base in Benghazi, Libya, and UN News said the UN mission there urged an investigation of attacks at the port.

sources.title: Leaders explain why climate talks ended without a deal
COP31 closes without a climate pact
Security Council meets on attacks in Ukraine
Russian strike near Kyiv hits apartment building
Warship reportedly struck at Libyan naval base
